limitations: Historical dates and prior strategy outcomes have been examined repeatedly; this is exploratory validation, not an untouched holdout.
Current swap snapshot held constant over history, with historical constant EUR tick valuation. Daily historical financing and conversion rates unavailable.
MT5 returned invalid triple-day code7; explicit Wednesday triple assumption retained. Primary broker midnight GMT+3 with GMT+2 sensitivity; historical clock/DST policy not reconstructed.
Stress doubles commissions, adverse market/stop slippage and negative swap debits, leaves credits unchanged. Observed spreads unchanged; fallback1 to2 pips.
Independent continuous EUR10k accounts per window/model; no monthly resets or concurrent portfolio aggregation. Drawdown samples M1-close equity and actual fills; intrabar loss can be larger.
Historical margin, execution latency, missing liquidity, tick paths and changing broker stop/volume constraints not reconstructed. No live settings, bot or orders.
plan.entry_definitions_source: src/strategy/fast_scalp.py; unchanged thresholds from prior entry study
plan.rules: M1 decisions, closed M5 EMA20/50 trend and slope, causal sweep/reclaim/displacement, structure6-15 raw pips plus0.2 pip padding. Spread cap0.7, initial2R target and1.5R/1R trailing. Both sides30-minute cap, weekday05:00-18:00 UTC entries and flat by19:00. Full0.5% price-risk budget with recorded broker volume ceiling, not arbitrary lots. Original cooldown/daily/single-position protection retained.
plan.selection: For USDCHF nominate highest earlier stressed net among positive, participating, zero-financing/no-overnight candidates; otherwise cash. Tie lower sampled drawdown then name. Lock before later/full new-entry outcomes. All three models and both cost levels reported; not mixed into old-path ranking.
plan.clock_sensitivity: Primary GMT+3 swap enabled. Audit entire positions under GMT+2 as well; if no events under either and the UTC exit policy is fixed, clock is path-equivalent. Retain and flag any financing violation.
